items.question: Which customer owes us the most on unpaid, non-cancelled invoices?
items.author: team

B0.sql:
WITH paid AS (
    SELECT k.InvoiceDocKey,
           SUM(k.Amount) AS PaidAmt
    FROM ARPaymentKnockOff k
    JOIN ARPayment p
      ON p.DocKey = k.PaymentDocKey
     AND p.Cancelled = 'F'
    GROUP BY k.InvoiceDocKey
),
credited AS (
    SELECT c.InvoiceDocKey,
           SUM(c.TotalIncTax) AS CreditedAmt
    FROM CN c
    WHERE c.Cancelled = 'F'
    GROUP BY c.InvoiceDocKey
),
inv AS (
    SELECT i.DocKey,
           i.DebtorCode,
           i.TotalIncTax,
           COALESCE(p.PaidAmt, 0) AS PaidAmt,
           COALESCE(c.CreditedAmt, 0) AS CreditedAmt,
           i.TotalIncTax - COALESCE(p.PaidAmt, 0) - COALESCE(c.CreditedAmt, 0) AS Outstanding
    FROM IV i
    LEFT JOIN paid p
      ON p.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
    LEFT JOIN credited c
      ON c.InvoiceDocKey = i.DocKey
    WHERE i.Cancelled = 'F'
)
SELECT d.CompanyName,
       i.DebtorCode,
       SUM(i.Outstanding) AS TotalOutstanding
FROM inv i
JOIN Debtor d
  ON d.AccNo = i.DebtorCode
WHERE i.Outstanding > 0
GROUP BY i.DebtorCode, d.CompanyName
ORDER BY TotalOutstanding DESC
LIMIT 1;

items.question: How many customers have unpaid invoices overdue by more than 90 days, as of the latest invoice date?
items.author: team

B0.sql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT MAX(iv.DocDate) AS RefDate
    FROM IV iv
    WHERE COALESCE(iv.Cancelled, '') <> 'Y'
),
paid AS (
    SELECT k.InvoiceDocKey, SUM(k.Amount) AS PaidAmt
    FROM ARPaymentKnockOff k
    JOIN ARPayment p ON p.DocKey = k.PaymentDocKey
    WHERE COALESCE(p.Cancelled, '') <> 'Y'
    GROUP BY k.InvoiceDocKey
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT iv.DebtorCode) AS OverdueCustomerCount
FROM IV iv
CROSS JOIN latest
LEFT JOIN paid ON paid.InvoiceDocKey = iv.DocKey
WHERE COALESCE(iv.Cancelled, '') <> 'Y'
  AND iv.DueDate IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday(latest.RefDate) - julianday(iv.DueDate) > 90
  AND iv.TotalIncTax > COALESCE(paid.PaidAmt, 0);

B1.sql:
WITH latest_invoice AS (
  SELECT MAX(DocDate) AS latest_date
  FROM IV
  WHERE Cancelled = 'F'
),
invoice_payments AS (
  SELECT k.InvoiceDocKey, SUM(k.Amount) AS amount_paid
  FROM ARPaymentKnockOff k
  JOIN ARPayment p ON p.DocKey = k.PaymentDocKey
  WHERE p.Cancelled = 'F'
  GROUP BY k.InvoiceDocKey
),
invoice_credits AS (
  SELECT c.InvoiceDocKey, SUM(c.TotalIncTax) AS amount_credited
  FROM CN c
  WHERE c.Cancelled = 'F'
  GROUP BY c.InvoiceDocKey
),
unpaid_overdue AS (
  SELECT iv.DebtorCode
  FROM IV iv
  CROSS JOIN latest_invoice li
  LEFT JOIN invoice_payments ip ON ip.InvoiceDocKey = iv.DocKey
  LEFT JOIN invoice_credits ic ON ic.InvoiceDocKey = iv.DocKey
  WHERE iv.Cancelled = 'F'
    AND iv.DueDate IS NOT NULL
    AND (julianday(li.latest_date) - julianday(iv.DueDate)) > 90
    AND (iv.TotalIncTax - COALESCE(ip.amount_paid, 0) - COALESCE(ic.amount_credited, 0)) > 0.005
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DebtorCode) AS customer_count
FROM unpaid_overdue;

B2.sql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT MAX(iv.DocDate) AS RefDate
    FROM IV iv
    WHERE COALESCE(iv.Cancelled, '') <> 'Y'
),
paid AS (
    SELECT k.InvoiceDocKey, SUM(k.Amount) AS PaidAmt
    FROM ARPaymentKnockOff k
    JOIN ARPayment p ON p.DocKey = k.PaymentDocKey
    WHERE COALESCE(p.Cancelled, '') <> 'Y'
    GROUP BY k.InvoiceDocKey
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT iv.DebtorCode) AS OverdueCustomerCount
FROM IV iv
CROSS JOIN latest
LEFT JOIN paid ON paid.InvoiceDocKey = iv.DocKey
WHERE COALESCE(iv.Cancelled, '') <> 'Y'
  AND iv.DueDate IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday(latest.RefDate) - julianday(iv.DueDate) > 90
  AND iv.TotalIncTax > COALESCE(paid.PaidAmt, 0);

  SELECT MAX(DocDate) AS latest_date
  FROM IV
  WHERE Cancelled = 'F'

SELECT

    i.Description,
    i.ItemGroup,
    i.UOM,
